checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate vertical assets: poster and 8s reel
must.why: Poster is a vertical still; reel is vertical, 8s per the description and frames.

must.item: Both contain all five strings spelled exactly
must.why: All five lines are spelled correctly in the poster and in the reel frames. Light strings temporarily cover some letters in the reel.

must.item: Both show warm illustrated stalls and string lights with matching palette
must.why: Same warm orange/navy illustrated market, though the layouts differ.

must.item: Reel has visible background animation while details remain readable throughout
must.why: Lights move and steam rises, but at 3.2s a string of lights cuts across 'Free entry', and at 5.6s lights cover 'Saturday 12 July'. Readability is lost at those moments.
Audio can't be checked from frames. The assistant states there is no sound.

exact_text.read_as: Saturday 12 July (partly covered by lights at 5.6s)
Free entry (a light string crosses it at 3.2s)

faults.what: Light strings and lanterns sweep over the text in the reel. 'Saturday 12 July' is partly hidden at 5.6s and 'Free entry' is crossed at 3.2s. This breaks the 'readable throughout' requirement.
The poster and reel layouts differ. The poster has big stacked title text and a bottom banner, while the reel has centred text at the top. The match is only in style.
The reel text is plain overlay-like text with no backing, and it has low contrast where lights pass behind it.
The lights near the text change position a lot between frames. This looks like AI drift in the animation.

summary: The poster is attractive and the text is correct. The reel has the right look and correct spelling, but swinging light strings pass over the text and hide parts of it at some moments, so it is not readable throughout.
